system.description:
Range: Self

Area: 5-space-radius

You and your allies take on the form White Foxes, granting you speed, stealth, and protection from predators.

Choose yourself and a number of allies within a 10-space-radius, with a maximum number equal to your soul. Until the start of your next turn, you and your affected allies gain the following effects for as long as they remain within 10 spaces of you.

  • Your Size becomes 1/2.

  • Your Stride speed increases by +5.

  • You gain a bonus to your Training in Stealth equal to the Training in Metaphysics of the creature that used this ability.

  • Most animals will ignore you unless you provoke them first.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.
